messages.author: e91fe47eb8f66691
messages.subject: Shiny - reactive mapview
parts:
Hello,

Is there anyway to make reactive mapview ?

I tried to make the following map reactive : when selecting the zipcode in the select input, the map should be re-generate with the data corresponding to the selected zipcode.
I tried the following code and R send me this message :

Error in .getReactiveEnvironment()$currentContext() : 
  Operation not allowed without an active reactive context. (You tried to do something that can only be done from inside a reactive expression or observer.)

Thanks a lot,

Anthony


reproductible example :

library(shiny)
library(mapview)

ui <- fluidPage(
  selectInput('zipcode', 'ZIP CODE', c("91438"="91438","91257"="91257")),
  mapviewOutput("reactive_mapplot")
 )


server<-shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {  
  output$reactive_mapplot<- renderMapview({mapview(breweries91[which(breweries91$"zipcode"==input$zipcode),])})
 
})

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
